note: Provenance log: which primary sources verified which curated facts, and when. Populated during sonnet primary-source verification passes so the reasoning survives past the (transient) agent runs. `scripts/apply-verification.mjs` stamps confidence:'verified' + verifiedAt + verifiedSources onto the listed terms. `pnpm verify:status` reports what is still inferred (haiku-only) and thus a target for the next verification pass.

entries.method: sonnet — downloaded + grepped live TFDA open-data CSVs: food-additive 附表一 (export/61, 875KB UTF-8) and food raw-material positive list (export/4, 11MB); confirmed item numbers, categories, and quantitative limits directly from source rows
entries.facts: PGPR = additive item 16021 (交酯化蓖麻酸聚合甘油酯), emulsifier cat.16, GMP all foods EXCEPT fresh/UHT milk. Propylene glycol alginate = item 12002 (海藻酸丙二醇), thickener cat.12, ≤10 g/kg. L-isoleucine = nutrient additive, all foods as-needed for nutrient supplementation, no numeric cap. HMB: ONLY calcium salt 3-羥基-3-甲基丁酸鈣 listed (營養添加劑), restricted to 特殊營養食品 (special/medical nutritional foods) only + label '不適宜孕婦及未滿18歲者' — free HMB/other salts NOT listed. Cytidine: free form NOT listed; only CMP salt 5'-胞核苷單磷酸鹽 (infant<3 formula ≤2.50 mg/100kcal, combined 5-nucleotide cap 5 mg/100kcal). Uridine: free NOT listed; only UMP salt 5'-尿核苷單磷酸鹽 (≤1.75 mg/100kcal, same combined cap). Orotic acid (乳清酸) ZERO hits in either CSV = not permitted. Gum ghatti (哥地膠), tamarind gum (羅望子膠), pullulan (普魯蘭膠, Aureobasidium pullulans) all present on raw-material positive list (NOT additives). Rechecks confirmed absent from both CSVs: theaflavin(茶黃素), fisetin(非瑟酮), pinitol(松醇), trehalulose(海藻酮糖), resistant starch(抗性澱粉 standalone), wheat gluten(小麥蛋白).

entries.method: sonnet — downloaded + grepped live TFDA open-data CSVs: food-additive 附表一 (export/61) and food raw-material positive list incl. 未確認安全性 rows (export/4); cosmetic status via haiku web check of TFDA prohibited/restricted lists (negative-list regime)
entries.facts: Carmine/cochineal (胭脂蟲/胭脂紅/carminic) ABSENT from 著色劑 list = not a permitted Taiwan food colorant (contrast EU E120/US GRAS); NOT to be confused with 食用紅色六號/Cochineal Red A (=Ponceau 4R synthetic) or 蟲漆酸/Laccaic Acid (a listed insect colorant). Spirulina alga (藻體) = permitted raw material but phycocyanin/藻藍素 colorant NOT on 著色劑 list. Monk fruit 羅漢果 fruit = permitted raw material; Mogroside Extract 羅漢果醣苷萃取物 = listed 甜味劑 additive (QS). Yeast β-glucan (β-聚葡萄糖, microbial: A.pullulans/S.cerevisiae) = permitted raw material, distinct from cereal β-glucan. Purified phosphatidylcholine (磷脂醯膽鹼, 純化物) is on 未確認安全性 list = NOT permitted; but lecithin 卵磷脂 (plant+animal) IS a permitted raw material. MCT oil 中鏈三酸甘油酯 = permitted raw material (from edible oils). Green tea EGCG (表沒食子兒茶素沒食子酸酯) = permitted raw material, ≥90% purity, daily limit 300 mg EGCG (2024 衛授食字1131301534). Piperine 胡椒鹼 = permitted raw material, alcohol-extracted ≥95% purity, daily limit 12 mg (same 2024 announcement). Elderberry: Sambucus nigra/canadensis/sieboldiana FRUIT+FLOWER permitted; S. williamsii leaf & S. formosana on 未確認安全性 (species/part specific). UNVERIFIED (absent from all lists, gray-zone not banned): fucoxanthin(褐藻黃素), CLA(共軛亞麻油酸), apigenin(芹菜素), sulforaphane(蘿蔔硫素) — note broccoli SEED extract 青花菜種子萃取物 IS permitted (adults only, 115 mg/day, thyroid warning) but that is seed extract, not sulforaphane or sprout extract.

entries.method: sonnet — downloaded + grepped live TFDA open-data CSVs: food-additive 附表一 營養添加劑 (export/61) and food raw-material positive list incl. 微生物菌種 + 未確認安全性 rows (export/4); reported per-form nutrient limits and permitted microbial species verbatim
entries.facts: Vitamin D3 膽鈣化醇 = nutrient additive, capsule/tablet ≤800 IU(20μg)/day, general/infant ≤15μg/day, D2+D3 combined ratio ≤1. Methylcobalamin 甲鈷胺 = nutrient additive, capsule/tablet B12 ≤1000μg/day. Methylfolate = permitted raw material ONLY as (6S)-5-甲基四氫葉酸葡萄糖胺鹽 salt, limits follow 葉酸 (≤800/600/225μg). Selenomethionine 甲硫胺酸硒 = nutrient additive, capsule/tablet Se ≤200μg/day. Selenium yeast 硒酵母 (S. cerevisiae 菌體) = permitted raw material, Se ≤200μg/day. L. rhamnosus (乳酸菌, incl. Lacticaseibacillus synonym) + S. boulardii (under 啤酒酵母/Yeast) = permitted strains, unrestricted food use. Propionibacterium freudenreichii (丙酸桿菌) = listed but RESTRICTED to 'starter culture for Swiss cheese' only. Postbiotics (後生元): NO dedicated TFDA category (gray-zone). Sesamin 芝麻素 = permitted raw material, ≥60% purity, 15mg/day (2024 衛授食字1131301534). CMC 羧甲基纖維素鈉/鈣 = additive 粘稠劑, all foods ≤20g/kg (cross-linked tablets-only ≤50g/kg). α-Glucosyl hesperidin 醣化橙皮苷 = permitted raw material ≥30%, 450mg/day; plain hesperidin on 未確認安全性. Enzyme-modified/glucosyl rutin 芸香苷: NO permitted form (plain rutin on 未確認安全性) = not permitted. UNVERIFIED gray-zone (absent, not banned): nicotinamide riboside/NR (only 菸鹼酸/菸鹼醯胺 listed as B3), urolithin A, collagen tripeptide (parent 膠原蛋白/明膠 permitted), spinosin (source herb 酸棗仁 permitted but 不得單一原料使用).

entries.method: sonnet — grepped live TFDA food-additive 附表一 (export/61) for base 丙二醇, distinguishing it from alginate/fatty-acid-ester derivatives; plus deterministic common-name alias enrichment of existing basic-ingredient terms
entries.facts: Propylene glycol base 丙二醇 (English name per TFDA: 'Propylene Glycol', = 1,2-propanediol, CAS 57-55-6, E1520) = permitted food additive, category (十五) 載體/Carrier, QS in all foods EXCEPT fresh/UHT milk (鮮乳/保久乳). Distinct from 1,3-propanediol (CAS 504-63-2), which is a cosmetic ingredient absent from the food-additive CSV — the KB previously conflated the two under term cdict-propanediol; the erroneous 丙二醇/Propylene Glycol aliases were removed from cdict-propanediol and this dedicated term created.

entries.method: sonnet — grepped live TFDA food-additive 附表一 (export/61) for base free acids (乳酸/蘋果酸/酒石酸/反丁烯二酸/醋酸/磷酸), distinguished from their salts; plus deterministic Korean common-name alias enrichment of existing basic food-additive terms
entries.facts: Lactic acid 乳酸 (E270) = additive cat.(十一) 調味劑, QS all foods (mfg/processing necessity), excl. fresh/UHT milk — NEW dedicated term (previously only landed in cosmetic AHA grab-bag). Malic acid listed only as DL-蘋果酸(羥基丁二酸), 調味劑, QS, PROHIBITED in infant food (嬰兒食品不得使用) + excl. fresh/UHT milk. Tartaric (酒石酸), fumaric (反丁烯二酸), acetic (醋酸 + glacial 冰醋酸) all 調味劑, QS all foods. Phosphoric acid 磷酸 = ONLY free acid with scope+numeric limit: cola + tea beverages ONLY, ≤0.6 g/kg (its phosphate salts are separate entries capped ~3 g/kg as phosphate). All excl. fresh/UHT milk, mfg-necessity restriction.

entries.method: sonnet — grepped live TFDA food-additive 附表一 (export/61) + raw-material list (export/4) for 活性炭/活性碳, 碳酸鈉, DL-蘋果酸鈉; distinguished base substances from related salts and confirmed category/scope/restriction
entries.facts: Activated carbon (活性炭/活性碳): ZERO entries in both additive and raw-material CSVs — not a positive-listed additive nor raw material (appears only as a process-step verb '活性碳處理' inside other raw-material specs). Under positive-list rule, not usable as a named food additive; may function as a processing aid (加工助劑) removed before final product, a separate regime. Sodium carbonate has TWO legit listings: (七) 品質改良/釀造/食品製造用劑 碳酸鈉·無水碳酸鈉 QS mfg-necessity; and (十四) 食品工業用化學藥品 碳酸鈉(無水) QS but MUST be neutralized/removed before final product (最後製品完成前必須中和或去除). Both exclude fresh/UHT milk. Sodium DL-malate (DL-蘋果酸鈉, E350) = (十一) 調味劑, QS, PROHIBITED in infant food (嬰兒食品不得使用, same as free DL-malic acid) + excl. fresh/UHT milk. Distinct from 碳酸氫鈉/sodium bicarbonate (六 膨脹劑) and 碳酸鈣/calcium carbonate (七 + 八, 10g/kg or 1800mg/day).

entries.method: sonnet — grepped live TFDA raw-material (export/4, incl. 未確認安全性) + additive (export/61) CSVs for starches/extracts/capsaicin; fetched current TFDA mandatory-allergen announcement (衛授食字第1071302165號, effective 2020-07-01) for the 11-allergen list
entries.facts: Potato (馬鈴薯) absent from positive+unconfirmed lists = traditional staple food (like rice/wheat), native potato starch is food not additive (modified starches are separate 增稠劑 entries). Cassava/tapioca (樹薯；木薯 Manihot esculenta) listed 可供直接食用 (塊根·葉); native tapioca starch = food; TFDA record carries NO cyanogenic caveat despite cassava's cyanide content. Kelp/kombu (海帶；昆布 Laminaria japonica) permitted algae raw material (藻體) + 5 related species. Shiitake (香菇；香蕈 Lentinula edodes) permitted (子實體·菌絲體); 香菰/冬菇 are unofficial spellings. Isolated CAPSAICIN (辣椒素) ABSENT from all lists = no food pathway; chili FRUIT (辣椒；番椒 果實) permitted as spice but chili LEAF (葉) is on 未確認安全性 (prohibited). Taiwan mandatory ALLERGEN list = 11 categories (crustaceans, mango, peanut, cow/goat milk, egg, tree nuts, sesame, gluten cereals, soybean, fish, sulfites≥10mg/kg), effective 2020-07-01, still current (no 2024/2025 revision). BUCKWHEAT (蕎麥) is NOT on Taiwan's list (contrast Korea) — and Taiwan uniquely requires MANGO (芒果) which Korea does not.

entries.method: sonnet — grepped live TFDA food-additive (export/61) + raw-material (export/4) CSVs and the cosmetic COLORANT open-data list (InfoId=200) + official restriction-table PDF (2021-07-01); enriched existing basic terms with missing common names
entries.facts: Ultramarines CI 77007 and Manganese violet CI 77742 both on TFDA cosmetic colorant permitted list at 使用範圍 class 1 (all cosmetics incl. eye area; colorant class legend: 1=all, 2=except eye, 3=no mucous membrane, 4=brief skin contact only). Guarana (瓜拿那；瓜拿納, Paullinia cupana) permitted raw material, seed (種子), daily cap 2.4 g (caffeine-bearing). HFCS/果葡糖漿/高果糖玉米糖漿 (isoglucose): ABSENT from both additive and raw-material lists — ordinary corn-derived manufactured sweetener outside both positive-list regimes (corn itself is a permitted raw material). Fructo-oligosaccharide 果寡糖 (FOS) permitted raw material; XOS 木寡醣, GOS 半乳寡糖, IMO 異麥芽寡糖 also separately listed. Note: 'BHA' is an ambiguous abbreviation — cosmetic BHA = salicylic acid (beta hydroxy acid), food BHA = butylated hydroxyanisole 丁基羥基茴香醚 (antioxidant); both now surface.

entries.method: sonnet — grepped live TFDA food-additive 附表一 (export/61, incl. 十 香料 flavorings) + raw-material (export/4) CSVs; read the cosmetic fragrance-allergen draft gazette (行政院公報 doc 03101420250121, 2025-01-21)
entries.facts: Coenzyme Q10 (輔酵素Q10) permitted raw material, daily limit 30 mg + mandatory warning label (unsuitable for <15yo, pregnant/breastfeeding, warfarin patients), per 2019 衛授食字1081302650; ubiquinol (reduced form) NOT separately listed. Benzyl benzoate (苯甲酸苄酯), acetoin (乙偶姻), diacetyl (丁二酮) are ALL ABSENT from the TFDA 香料/additive positive list = NOT permitted food flavorings (contrast benzyl acetate/alcohol/propionate which ARE listed under 十 香料). Taiwan cosmetic fragrance-allergen disclosure regime 「化粧品應標示之特定香精或香料成分」 = 24 substances (EU-based, minus banned HICC/BMHCA), disclose actual name when >0.01% rinse-off / >0.001% leave-on; benzyl benzoate is item #17. STATUS: still DRAFT (announced 2025-01-21, not formally promulgated; effective 1 year after promulgation).

entries.method: 3 sonnet agents — grepped live TFDA raw-material CSV (export/4; 可供食品使用之原料 + 未確認安全性 rows) for 38 Korean/TCM botanicals by species + part (部位) + restriction (備註)
entries.facts: TFDA raw-material list is NON-exhaustive (header: absence != prohibited); only 未確認安全性 rows are explicit bars. Species/part traps for Korean health foods: KOREAN angelica 韓國當歸/A.gigas BARRED (Chinese 當歸/A.sinensis only seed/stem/leaf); Korean/Japanese cnidium 日本川芎/Cnidium officinale BARRED (Chinese 川芎 rhizome permitted, 不得單一原料); 산수유 山茱萸 BARRED; 더덕 羊乳/C.lanceolata BARRED (黨參/C.pilosula permitted, 不得單一原料); Korean 복분자 R.coreanus ABSENT + TCM 掌葉覆盆子/R.chingii BARRED; genuine 백수오 C.wilfordii ABSENT (only adulterant C.auriculatum/牛皮消 listed); 쑥 艾/A.argyi BARRED; 엉겅퀴 大薊·小薊 BARRED; 차가버섯 白樺茸 BARRED; 개똥쑥 A.annua ABSENT (青蒿 CSV row = Tarragon A.dracunculus, name-collision trap); 히비스커스 calyx OK but fruit BARRED; 노니 fruit OK but leaf restricted (dried teabag, 1g/day, warning); 동충하초 form-split (complex=不得單一, 蛹蟲草 C.militaris separate dose caps); 상황버섯 mycelium 3g/day; 민들레 蒲公英 100mg/day (10mg powder); 우엉 root unresolved (牛蒡子 barred); 양파 leaf BARRED (extract 1000mg quercetin). Restricted '不得單一原料使用' (not sole ingredient): 川芎·白芍·熟地·黃耆·黨參. Permitted: 갈근·둥굴레·대추·도라지·생강·마늘·매실·연잎·뽕잎·감잎·돼지감자·녹용·영지·인진쑥·카모마일·보이차/우롱차(Camellia).

entries.method: 5 parallel sonnet agents — grepped live TFDA raw-material (export/4, permitted + 未確認安全性) + additive (export/61, 營養添加劑/調味劑/防腐劑) CSVs by species + part (部位) + restriction (備註) for spices, seaweeds, fermented foods, marine/animal items, and amino/mineral nutrients
entries.facts: SPICES part-split/species traps: black pepper fruit OK but STEM barred; star anise fruit OK but LEAF barred + Japanese star anise 莽草/I.anisatum toxic (absent, never use); sage whole-plant OK (tea/extract) but SEED barred + many Salvia barred; dill flower barred; wasabi flower barred; clove 不得單一原料使用; nutmeg no myristicin limit; TFDA 牛至 = marjoram NOT true oregano (奧勒岡草); thyme only tea/extract category; Zanthoxylum avicennae barred. SEAWEED: laver/wakame/hijiki/gelidium/dulse/chlorella permitted (hijiki inorganic-arsenic handled by separate heavy-metal standard, not this list); Sargassum species-split (fusiforme/horneri OK, fulvellum barred); maesaengi/codium/fucoidan absent (gray). FERMENTED (2-layer: finished food ordinary + strain on permitted-microbe list): natto/miso/gochujang/koji(Aspergillus oryzae)/vinegar(Acetobacter)/tempeh(Rhizopus oligosporus) OK; nattokinase enzyme BARRED (vs natto food OK); kombucha no named entry; acid-HVP 3-MCPD governed by separate contaminant standard. MARINE: mussel/cuttlefish-ink(4 Sepia spp incl ink)/chitin(shrimp/crab shell) permitted; scallop absent-traditional; protamine ABSENT from raw-material AND 防腐劑 lists = not approved; chitosan conditional (warning labels + A.niger OTA<1ppb, NOT a numeric cap). SUPP: L-glutamine permitted (營養添加劑); L-carnitine cap/tab ≤2g/day; L-theanine only as 調味劑 ≤1g/kg; GABA raw-material fermented ≥20% ≤100mg/day + warning; beta-alanine ABSENT (not permitted); minerals Zn(≤30/22.5/7.5mg) Mg(≤600/105mg) Fe(≤45/22.5/15mg) Se(≤200μg) with many salt forms.

entries.method: 4 parallel sonnet agents — TFDA additive 附表一 (export/61, 營養添加劑/防腐劑/乳化劑), raw-material (export/4), additive-license dataset (export/3), and cosmetic open-data lists (InfoId=199 restricted / 201 preservative / 202 UV / 203 prohibited)
entries.facts: COSMETIC (list#/limit): toluene-2,5-diamine restr#66 2%/3.6% oxidative-hairdye-only; p-aminophenol restr#69 0.9% hairdye-only; H2O2 restr#167 12%(hair)/6%(tooth+warning); ammonium persulfate restr#163 61.3% professional-only; homosalate UV#4 10%; 4-MBC/enzacamene UV#23 4%; drometrizole trisiloxane UV#12 15%; MIT preserv#29 0.0015% RINSE-OFF ONLY (leave-on banned); chlorphenesin preserv#34 0.3%; diazolidinyl urea preserv#53 0.5% formaldehyde<1000ppm; triclosan preserv#45 0.3%/0.2%mouthwash; oxybenzone/BP-3 UV#2 6% (0.5% protectant) + mandatory '含二苯酮-3' warning. entries.facts: CONTAMINANTS: inorganic-As rice tiers 0.35 brown/0.2 white/0.1 infant-food-raw; cadmium rice 0.4 + NEW chocolate 0.3-0.9/cocoa 2.0 effective 2026-01-01; mycotoxins (aflatoxin/OTA/patulin/DON/ZEN/fumonisin) all get infant-food sub-limits 10-40x stricter (B1 infant 0.10, M1 infant 0.025, patulin infant 10, DON infant 200); rice EXEMPT from DON; melamine liquid-infant-formula 0.15mg/kg (stricter than intl 1ppm); histamine fresh 200 / fermented 400; benzopyrene smoked meat 2.0/BBQ 5.0; dioxin needs ALL THREE metrics incl ICES-6 PCBs; acrylamide/nitrate/perchlorate NO binding limit. CONTACT: BPA migration 0.6ppm (stricter than KR ~2.5) + infant bottle BPA ban; melamine-ware melamine monomer 2.5ppm + formaldehyde non-detect; phthalates DEHP 1.5/DBP 0.3/BBP 30ppm + 8-phthalate 0.1wt% + under-3 4-phthalate ban; TW GAPS (no codified limit): silicone rubber, epoxy-can BPA, printing ink, PFAS FCM, teat nitrosamine. RESIDUES regime: pesticide positive-list + 0.01ppm default; vet-drug unlisted = 不得檢出 zero. Ractopamine — BOTH TW & KR ban domestic use + set import MRLs (TW pork 0.01/offal 0.04, beef muscle-only 0.01; KR kidney 0.09 = 2x TW) — real trap is organ/cut mismatch NOT ban-vs-allow. Clenbuterol/nitrofuran/malachite-green banned zero-tolerance (malachite ornamental-fish exception only). Glyphosate TW stricter than US. Chlorpyrifos phase-out sale-ban 2026. COSMETIC: human-derived exosomes & stem-cell CM on prohibited list #11 (exosomes have 2024 case-by-case exception; stem-cell CM does not); plant-derived unaffected. Growth factors/topical-botox-peptides/PDRN permitted as ingredients but medical/regenerative claims violate Cosmetic Act Art.10. Microbiome/copper-peptide/snail permitted.
